ko.title: 11월 1일 시간 되돌려: 미국이 여전히 시간 변경을 멈추지 못하는 이유

segments.src: In the early hours of **Sunday, November 1**, most of the United States will turn its clocks back one hour and return to standard time.
segments.tr: **11월 1일 일요일** 이른 아침, 미국 대부분 지역에서는 시계를 한 시간 뒤로 돌려 표준시로 돌아갑니다.

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: 많은 사람들이 한 시간 더 수면을 취하게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: 또한 많은 이들이 익숙한 질문을 던질 것입니다. 왜 우리는 여전히 이 일을 하고 있을까요?

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: 일년에 두 번 시계를 바꾸는 제도를 폐지하려는 노력은 양당, 백악관, 그리고 대중의 광범위한 지지를 받아왔습니다.

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: 일광 절약 시간을 영구화하기 위한 법안은 의회에서 다시 한번 교착 상태에 빠졌습니다.

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: 현재 논쟁의 위치는 어디이며, 연구 결과는 무엇을 말하고 있으며, 주 정부들이 왜 이 문제를 독자적으로 해결하지 못하는지 알아봅니다.

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## 현재 시스템의 작동 방식

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: 1966년의 통일 시간법(Uniform Time Act)은 일광 절약 시간(DST)을 위한 국가적 틀을 만들었습니다.

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: 오늘날의 규칙에 따르면, 일광 절약 시간은 3월 두 번째 일요일부터 11월 첫 번째 일요일까지 시행됩니다.

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: 주 정부들은 해당 법에 따라 제한된 선택권을 가집니다:

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **연중 표준시를 유지할 수 있습니다.** 하와이와 애리조나 대부분 지역이 여러 미국 영토와 함께 이를 시행하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **자체적으로 영구적인 일광 절약 시간을 채택할 수 없습니다.** 그 변경에는 의회의 법안 승인이 필요합니다.

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: 약 20개 주에서 의회가 허용할 경우 연중 일광 절약 시간을 채택하는 법안이나 결의안을 통과시켰습니다.

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: 그러한 조치들은 연방 법이 바뀔 때까지 보류되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## 추진이 정체된 이유

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: 가장 잘 알려진 제안은 일광 절약 시간을 연중으로 고정하는 '햇빛 보호법(Sunshine Protection Act)'입니다.

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: 상원은 2022년에 만장일치 동의로 이 법안의 버전을 통과시켰으나, 하원에서는 표결에 부쳐지지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: 이후 회기에서도 유사한 법안들이 다시 발의되었으며, 정치 지도자들의 지지 성명이 이어졌습니다.

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 어떤 법안도 대통령 책상에 도달하지 못했습니다.

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: 이 문제가 교착 상태에 머물게 하는 몇 가지 요인은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **어떤 시간을 영구화할지에 대한 의견 불일치.** 영구적인 일광 절약 시간 지지자들은 일년 내내 긴 여름 스타일의 저녁을 원합니다. 많은 수면 과학자들은 영구적인 *표준* 시간이 더 나은 선택이라고 주장합니다. 이 두 진영이 개혁 연합을 분열시키고 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **지역적 차이.** 일출과 일몰 시간은 전국적으로 크게 다릅니다. 영구적인 일광 절약 시간은 시간대의 일부 북부 및 서부 지역에서 매우 늦은 겨울 일출을 의미하게 됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **제한된 본회의 시간.** 의회에는 경합하는 우선순위가 많으며, 전국의 모든 시계에 영향을 미치는 변경 사항은 연기하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## 수면 증거가 말하는 것

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: 미국 수면 의학 학회(American Academy of Sleep Medicine)를 포함한 주요 수면 의학 단체들은 계절별 시간 변경의 폐지를 촉구해왔습니다.

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: 그들이 선호하는 옵션은 신체의 자연스러운 명암 주기에 더 가깝게 부합하기 때문에 영구적인 표준시입니다.

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: 연구원들은 한 시간을 잃어버리는 봄철 시간 변경을 수면 부족 및 주간 졸음 증가와 같은 단기적 장애와 연관 지었습니다.

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: 일부 연구에서는 또한 봄철 시간 변경 후 며칠 동안 심장마비 및 뇌졸중 위험이 작고 일시적으로 증가한다는 사실을 발견했습니다.

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: 이러한 발견은 모든 개인이 겪게 될 위험이 아니라 대규모 인구에 걸친 평균을 설명하지만, 건강 단체들이 시간 변경 중단을 지지하는 주된 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## 안전과 에너지

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 안전 측면의 그림은 엇갈립니다.

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: 저녁의 일광은 황혼 무렵 보행자와 관련된 일부 범죄와 교통사고를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: 영구적인 일광 절약 시간 하에서의 더 어두운 겨울 아침은 등굣길 어린이들과 이른 통근자들의 위험을 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: 시간 변경 후의 충돌 비율에 대한 연구에서도 특히 봄철 변경 후에 단기적인 급증이 발견되었습니다.

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: 원래의 에너지 절약 주장은 많은 사람들이 가정하는 것보다 약합니다.

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: 현대 연구들은 일반적으로 전력 사용량에 미치는 영향이 미미하며, 일부 지역에서는 정책이 시작된 이후 난방, 냉방 및 전자제품 사용이 변경되었기 때문에 거의 0에 가깝다고 봅니다.

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## 경제적 주장

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: 기업 단체, 소매업체, 레크리에이션 및 관광 부문은 종종 퇴근 후 밝을 때 사람들이 쇼핑하고 더 많이 지출한다고 주장하며 더 많은 저녁 일광을 지지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 봄철 시간 변경 후 생산성 저하로 인한 비용과, 특히 운송, 방송, 금융 분야에서 시간대에 걸쳐 일정을 조율하는 혼란으로 인한 비용을 지적합니다.

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: 경제적 영향에 대한 추정치는 사용된 방법에 따라 크게 다르므로 주의해서 다루어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## 1970년대의 교훈

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국은

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: 이를 전에 시도한 적이 있습니다.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: 1974년, 의회는 에너지 절약 실험으로 연중 일광 절약 시간을 승인했습니다.

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: 첫 번째 어두운 겨울 아침 동안 대중의 지지가 떨어졌고, 의회는 다음 해에 그 조치를 폐기했습니다.

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: 그 역사는 입법자들과 과학자들이 어떤 영구적인 시간을 선택할지에 대해 주의를 기울일 것을 촉구하는 주된 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## 이번 11월에 예상되는 것

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 법적으로 변경되는 것이 없습니다.

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: 11월 1일에 일출과 일몰이 한 시간 앞당겨지고, 저녁은 더 일찍 어두워질 것입니다.

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 조치가 적응을 도울 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - 미리 몇 일 동안 취침 시간을 15~20분 앞당깁니다.

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - 시간 변경 후 아침에 야외 빛을 쬐십시오.

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - 식사 및 기상 시간을 일정하게 유지하십시오.

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - 운전자와 보행자가 이른 어둠에 적응하고 있는 황혼 무렵 운전할 때 특별히 주의하십시오.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: 미국인들은 설문조사에서 시간 변경의 종식을 원한다고 말하지만, 어떤 시간을 유지할지에 대해서는 의견이 덜 일치합니다.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: 의회가 하나를 선택하고 주 정부가 행동할 옵션이나 지침을 얻을 때까지, 시계는 일년에 두 번 계속 움직일 것입니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: 한편, 증거는 하나의 명확한 결론을 뒷받침합니다. 어떤 시간이 선택되든 연중 내내 유지하는 것이 앞뒤로 전환하는 것보다 낫다는 것입니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 의학적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: 수면이나 건강에 대한 우려가 있는 사람은 자격을 갖춘 건강 전문가와 상담해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 11月1日时钟拨回一小时：为什么美国依然无法就停止调时达成一致

segments.src: In the early hours of **Sunday, November 1**, most of the United States will turn its clocks back one hour and return to standard time.
segments.tr: 在**11月1日，星期日**的清晨，美国大部分地区将把时钟拨慢一小时，恢复标准时间。

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: 许多人将享受额外一小时的睡眠。

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: 许多人也会提出一个熟悉的问题：为什么我们仍在这样做？

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: 终止每年两次调时工作的努力得到了两党、白宫以及大部分公众的支持。

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: 使夏令时永久化的法案再次在国会搁浅。

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: 以下是辩论现状、研究结论，以及为什么各州无法自行解决这一问题。

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## 当前系统如何运作

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: 1966 年的《统一时间法案》为夏令时（DST）建立了全国性框架。

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: 根据现行规则，夏令时从 3 月的第二个星期日持续到 11 月的第一个星期日。

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: 在该法律下，各州的选择有限：

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **他们可以全年实行标准时间。** 夏威夷州和亚利桑那州的大部分地区，以及若干美国领地都是如此。

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **他们不能自行采用永久夏令时。** 这一变更需要国会通过法案。

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: 大约有 20 个州已经通过了法律或决议，如果国会允许，他们将采用全年夏令时。

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: 在联邦法律修改之前，这些措施一直处于闲置状态。

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## 为什么推动陷入停滞

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: 最著名的提议是《阳光保护法案》，该法案将全年锁定夏令时。

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: 参议院于 2022 年通过一致同意方式通过了一个版本，但该版本从未在众议院接受表决。

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: 后续会期中重新引入了相关版本，政治领导人也发表了公开支持声明。

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，仍未有任何法案送交总统签署。

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: 有几点原因导致该议题卡住：

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **关于将哪种时间永久化的分歧。** 永久夏令时的支持者希望全年拥有漫长的夏季风格傍晚。许多睡眠科学家主张永久*标准*时间是更好的选择。这两个阵营分化了改革联盟。

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **区域差异。** 全国各地的日出和日落时间差异很大。永久夏令时意味着时区内一些北部和西部地区的冬日日出会非常晚。

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **有限的议场审议时间。** 国会面临许多相互竞争的优先事项，而一项涉及全国每一个时钟的变更很容易被推迟。

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## 睡眠研究证据说了什么

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: 包括美国睡眠医学会在内的主要睡眠医学机构呼吁取消季节性调时。

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: 他们首选的方案是永久标准时间，因为它更符合人体自然的昼夜光照节律。

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: 研究人员将春季切换（丢失一小时）与短期干扰联系起来，例如睡眠减少和白天昏昏欲睡增加。

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: 一些研究还发现，在春季调时后的几天里，心肌梗死和中风风险有轻微的短暂增加。

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: 这些发现描述的是庞人群的平均状况，并非每个人都会经历的风险，但它们是健康团体主张停止调时的主要原因。

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## 安全与能源

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 安全方面的状况喜忧参半。

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: 傍晚的日光可以减少黄昏时分涉及行人的某些犯罪和交通碰撞。

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: 在永久夏令时下，更黑暗的冬季早晨可能会增加步行上学的儿童和早期通勤者的风险。

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: 对调时后事故率的研究也发现存在短暂的峰值，尤其是在春季调时之后。

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: 最初的节约能源论点比许多人假设的要弱。

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: 现代研究普遍发现，对用电量的影响微乎其微，在某些地区几乎为零，因为自该政策实施以来，供暖、冷却和电子设备的使用已发生改变。

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## 经济论点

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: 商业团体、零售商以及娱乐和旅游部门通常支持增加傍晚日光，认为人们在下班后天亮时会进行更多购物和消费。

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: 其他人则指出春季切换后生产力下降带来的成本，以及跨时区协调日程安排（特别是在运输、广播和金融领域）所引发的混乱成本。

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: 对经济影响的评估因所用方法的不同而差异很大，因此应谨慎对待。

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## 1970年代的教训

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: 以前尝试过这种做法。

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: 1974 年，国会批准了全年夏令时作为一项节能实验。

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: 在最初几个黑暗的冬季早晨，公众支持率下降，国会在次年废除了该措施。

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: 这段历史是立法者和科学家呼吁对选择哪种永久时间保持谨慎的主要原因。

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## 今年 11 月可以期待什么

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: 目前，法律没有任何改变。

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: 11 月 1 日的日出和日落将提前一小时，傍晚天黑得更早。

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: 一些实用步骤可以缓解这种适应过程：

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - 在此之前提前几天将睡觉时间提前 15 到 20 分钟。

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - 在调整后的早晨接受户外光照。

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - 保持固定的用餐和起床时间。

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - 在黄昏驾驶时格外小心，此时驾驶员和行人正在适应更早到来的黑夜。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: 美国人在调查中表示他们希望停止调时，但对于保留哪种时间意见不太统一。

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: 在国会做出选择、且各州获得采取行动的选择权或授权之前，时钟每年仍将移动两次。

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: 同时，证据支持一个明确的结论：无论选择哪种时间，全年保持不变可能都比来回切换更好。

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供参考，不构成医疗建议。

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: 有睡眠或健康疑虑的人应咨询合格的医疗专业人员。*

hi.title: घड़ियां 1 नवंबर को पीछे होंगी: अमेरिका अब भी समय बदलने को रोकने पर सहमत क्यों नहीं हो पा रहा है

segments.src: In the early hours of **Sunday, November 1**, most of the United States will turn its clocks back one hour and return to standard time.
segments.tr: **रविवार, 1 नवंबर** की सुबह तड़के, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के अधिकांश हिस्से अपनी घड़ियों को एक घंटा पीछे कर देंगे और मानक समय (standard time) पर लौट आएंगे।

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: कई लोग एक अतिरिक्त घंटे की नींद का आनंद लेंगे।

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: कई लोग एक जाना-पहचाना सवाल भी पूछ रहे होंगे: हम अब भी ऐसा क्यों कर रहे हैं?

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: साल में दो बार घड़ी बदलने की प्रक्रिया को समाप्त करने के प्रयासों को दोनों दलों, व्हाइट हाउस और जनता के बड़े हिस्से से समर्थन मिला है।

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: डेलाइट सेविंग टाइम को स्थायी बनाने का विधेयक कांग्रेस में फिर से अटक गया है।

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: यहां जानिए कि बहस किस मोड़ पर है, शोध क्या कहता है, और राज्य खुद इस मामले को क्यों नहीं सुलझा सकते।

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## वर्तमान प्रणाली कैसे काम करती है

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: 1966 के यूनिफॉर्म टाइम एक्ट ने डेलाइट सेविंग टाइम (DST) के लिए एक राष्ट्रीय ढांचा तैयार किया था।

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: आज के नियमों के तहत, DST मार्च के दूसरे रविवार से नवंबर के पहले रविवार तक चलता है।

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: उस कानून के तहत राज्यों के पास सीमित विकल्प हैं:

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **वे पूरे साल मानक समय पर रह सकते हैं।** हवाई और एरिजोना का अधिकांश हिस्सा अमेरिका के कई क्षेत्रों के साथ ऐसा ही करता है।

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **वे अपने दम पर स्थायी डेलाइट सेविंग टाइम नहीं अपना सकते।** उस बदलाव के लिए कांग्रेस के एक अधिनियम की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: लगभग बीस राज्यों ने ऐसे कानून या प्रस्ताव पारित किए हैं जो कांग्रेस द्वारा अनुमति दिए जाने पर पूरे साल डेलाइट सेविंग टाइम को अपनाएंगे।

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: वे उपाय तब तक निष्क्रिय पड़े रहते हैं जब तक कि संघीय कानून में बदलाव नहीं हो जाता।

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## यह प्रयास क्यों अटक गया है

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: सबसे प्रसिद्ध प्रस्ताव सनशाइन प्रोटेक्शन एक्ट है, जो पूरे साल डेलाइट टाइम को लागू कर देगा।

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: सीनेट ने 2022 में सर्वसम्मति से एक संस्करण पारित किया था, लेकिन इस पर हाउस ऑफ रिप्रेजेंटेटिव्स में कभी मतदान नहीं हुआ।

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: बाद के सत्रों में इसके नए संस्करण फिर से पेश किए गए हैं, और राजनीतिक नेताओं की ओर से समर्थन के सार्वजनिक बयान भी आए हैं।

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: फिर भी, कोई भी विधेयक राष्ट्रपति की मेज तक नहीं पहुंचा है।

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: कई बातें इस मुद्दे को अटका कर रखती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **किस समय को स्थायी बनाया जाए इस पर असहमति।** स्थायी डेलाइट समय के समर्थक पूरे साल गर्मियों जैसी लंबी शामें चाहते हैं। नींद से जुड़े कई वैज्ञानिकों का तर्क है कि स्थायी *मानक* समय बेहतर विकल्प है। ये दो गुट सुधार गठबंधन को विभाजित करते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **क्षेत्रीय अंतर।** देश भर में सूर्योदय और सूर्यास्त के समय में काफी अंतर होता है। स्थायी डेलाइट समय का अर्थ किसी समय क्षेत्र (time zone) के कुछ उत्तरी और पश्चिमी क्षेत्रों में सर्दियों की सुबह बहुत देर से सूर्योदय होना होगा।

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **संसद के पास सीमित समय।** कांग्रेस के पास कई प्रतिस्पर्धी प्राथमिकताएं हैं, और देश की हर घड़ी को प्रभावित करने वाले बदलाव को टालना आसान है।

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## नींद से जुड़े साक्ष्य क्या कहते हैं

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: अमेरिकन एकेडमी ऑफ स्लीप मेडिसिन सहित प्रमुख स्लीप मेडिसिन संगठनों ने मौसमी घड़ी के बदलावों को समाप्त करने का आह्वान किया है।

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: उनका पसंदीदा विकल्प स्थायी मानक समय है, क्योंकि यह शरीर के प्राकृतिक प्रकाश-अंधेरे चक्र से अधिक निकटता से मेल खाता है।

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: शोधकर्ताओं ने वसंत के बदलाव को, जब हम एक घंटा खो देते हैं, कम नींद और दिन में अधिक सुस्ती जैसी अल्पकालिक गड़बड़ियों से जोड़ा है।

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: कुछ अध्ययनों में वसंत के बदलाव के बाद के दिनों में दिल का दौरा और स्ट्रोक के जोखिम में मामूली, अस्थायी वृद्धि भी पाई गई है।

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: ये निष्कर्ष बड़ी आबादी के औसत को दर्शाते हैं, न कि ऐसा जोखिम जो हर व्यक्ति अनुभव करेगा, लेकिन स्वास्थ्य समूहों द्वारा इस बदलाव को समाप्त करने का समर्थन करने का यह एक मुख्य कारण है।

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## सुरक्षा और ऊर्जा

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: सुरक्षा की स्थिति मिली-जुली है।

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: शाम के समय उजाला रहने से कुछ अपराध और शाम को पैदल चलने वालों से जुड़े सड़क हादसे कम हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: स्थायी डेलाइट समय के तहत सर्दियों की सुबह अधिक अंधेरा होने से पैदल स्कूल जाने वाले बच्चों और सुबह काम पर निकलने वाले यात्रियों के लिए जोखिम बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: घड़ी के बदलाव के बाद दुर्घटना दरों पर किए गए शोध में भी अल्पकालिक वृद्धि देखी गई है, खासकर वसंत के बदलाव के बाद।

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा बचत का मूल तर्क उतना मजबूत नहीं है जितना कई लोग मानते हैं।

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: आधुनिक अध्ययनों में आम तौर पर पाया गया है कि बिजली के उपयोग पर इसका प्रभाव बहुत कम है, और कुछ क्षेत्रों में यह शून्य के करीब है, क्योंकि नीति शुरू होने के बाद से हीटिंग, कूलिंग और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स का उपयोग बदल गया है।

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## आर्थिक तर्क

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: व्यापारिक समूहों, खुदरा विक्रेताओं और मनोरंजन व पर्यटन क्षेत्रों ने अक्सर शाम को अधिक उजाला रहने का समर्थन किया है, उनका तर्क है कि जब काम के बाद रोशनी होती है तो लोग अधिक खरीदारी और खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग वसंत के बदलाव के बाद खोई हुई उत्पादकता के नुकसान और समय क्षेत्रों में समय-सारणी के समन्वय की भ्रम की स्थिति से होने वाली लागत की ओर इशारा करते हैं, विशेष रूप से परिवहन, प्रसारण और वित्त में।

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.

segments.src: ## The bottom line

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.

es.title: Los relojes se atrasan el 1 de noviembre: Por qué Estados Unidos todavía no puede ponerse de acuerdo para dejar de cambiar la hora

segments.src: In the early hours of **Sunday, November 1**, most of the United States will turn its clocks back one hour and return to standard time.
segments.tr: En las primeras horas del **domingo 1 de noviembre**, la mayor parte de Estados Unidos atrasará sus relojes una hora y volverá al horario estándar.

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: Muchas personas disfrutarán de una hora extra de sueño.

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: Muchos también se harán una pregunta familiar: ¿por qué seguimos haciendo esto?

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: Los esfuerzos para poner fin al cambio de hora dos veces al año han obtenido el apoyo de ambos partidos, de la Casa Blanca y de gran parte del público.

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: La legislación para hacer permanente el horario de verano se ha estancado nuevamente en el Congreso.

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: Aquí es donde se encuentra el debate, lo que dice la investigación y por qué los estados no pueden simplemente resolver el asunto por sí mismos.

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## Cómo funciona el sistema actual

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: La Ley de Hora Uniforme de 1966 creó un marco nacional para el horario de verano (DST, por sus siglas en inglés).

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: Según las reglas actuales, el horario de verano va desde el segundo domingo de marzo hasta el primer domingo de noviembre.

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: Los estados tienen opciones limitadas bajo esa ley:

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **Pueden mantener el horario estándar todo el año.** Hawái y la mayor parte de Arizona hacen esto, junto con varios territorios de EE. UU.

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **No pueden adoptar el horario de verano permanente por su cuenta.** Ese cambio requiere una ley del Congreso.

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente veinte estados han aprobado leyes o resoluciones que adoptarían el horario de verano durante todo el año si el Congreso lo permite.

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: Esas medidas permanecen inactivas hasta que cambie la ley federal.

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## Por qué se ha estancado el impulso

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: La propuesta más conocida es la Ley de Protección del Sol (Sunshine Protection Act), que fijaría el horario de verano durante todo el año.

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: El Senado aprobó una versión por consentimiento unánime en 2022, pero nunca recibió una votación en la Cámara de Representantes.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: Se han reintroducido versiones en sesiones posteriores y han seguido declaraciones públicas de apoyo por parte de líderes políticos.

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: Aun así, ningún proyecto de ley ha llegado al escritorio del presidente.

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: Varias cosas mantienen el problema estancado:

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **Desacuerdo sobre qué horario hacer permanente.** Los partidarios del horario de verano permanente quieren tardes largas al estilo veraniego durante todo el año. Muchos científicos del sueño argumentan que el horario *estándar* permanente es la mejor opción. Esos dos bandos dividen la coalición de reforma.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **Diferencias regionales.** Los horarios de salida y puesta del sol varían mucho en todo el país. El horario de verano permanente significaría amaneceres muy tardíos en invierno en algunas áreas del norte y oeste de una zona horaria.

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **Tiempo limitado en el pleno.** El Congreso tiene muchas prioridades en competencia, y un cambio que afecta a todos los relojes del país es fácil de posponer.

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## Lo que dice la evidencia sobre el sueño

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: Las principales organizaciones de medicina del sueño, incluida la Academia Estadounidense de Medicina del Sueño, han pedido eliminar los cambios de hora estacionales.

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: Su opción preferida es el horario estándar permanente, porque se ajusta más al ciclo natural de luz y oscuridad del cuerpo.

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: Los investigadores han relacionado el cambio de primavera, cuando perdemos una hora, con interrupciones a corto plazo, como menos sueño y más somnolencia durante el día.

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: Algunos estudios también han encontrado aumentos pequeños y temporales en el riesgo de ataque cardíaco y accidente cerebrovascular en los días posteriores al cambio de primavera.

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: Estos hallazgos describen promedios en grandes poblaciones, no un riesgo que cada individuo experimentará, pero son una razón principal por la que los grupos de salud favorecen terminar con el cambio.

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## Seguridad y energía

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: El panorama de seguridad es mixto.

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: La luz del día por la tarde puede reducir algunos delitos y colisiones de tráfico que involucran a peatones al anochecer.

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: Las mañanas de invierno más oscuras bajo el horario de verano permanente podrían aumentar los riesgos para los niños que caminan a la escuela y para los viajeros tempranos.

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: La investigación sobre las tasas de accidentes después de los cambios de hora también ha encontrado picos de corta duración, especialmente después del cambio de primavera.

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: El argumento original de ahorro de energía es más débil de lo que muchos suponen.

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: Los estudios modernos generalmente encuentran que el efecto en el uso de electricidad es pequeño, y en algunas regiones es cercano a cero, porque el uso de calefacción, refrigeración y electrónica ha cambiado desde que comenzó la política.

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## El argumento económico

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: Los grupos empresariales, los minoristas y los sectores de recreación y turismo a menudo han respaldado más luz diurna por la tarde, argumentando que la gente compra y gasta más cuando hay luz después del trabajo.

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: Otros señalan los costos derivados de la pérdida de productividad después del cambio de primavera y de la confusión de coordinar horarios entre zonas horarias, especialmente en el transporte, la radiodifusión y las finanzas.

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: Las estimaciones del efecto económico varían mucho según el método utilizado, por lo que deben tratarse con precaución.

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## La lección de la década de 1970

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: ya ha intentado esto antes.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: En 1974, el Congreso aprobó el horario de verano durante todo el año como un experimento de ahorro de energía.

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: El apoyo público cayó durante las primeras mañanas oscuras de invierno, y el Congreso derogó la medida al año siguiente.

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: Esa historia es una razón importante por la que los legisladores y científicos instan a tener cuidado sobre qué hora permanente elegir.

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## Qué esperar este noviembre

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: Por ahora, nada cambia en la ley.

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: La salida y la puesta del sol se desplazarán una hora antes el 1 de noviembre, y las tardes oscurecerán más pronto.

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: Algunos pasos prácticos pueden facilitar el ajuste:

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - Adelante la hora de acostarse de 15 a 20 minutos durante algunas noches antes.

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - Obtenga luz exterior por la mañana después del cambio.

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - Mantenga estables las horas de comida y de despertarse.

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - Tenga especial cuidado al conducir al anochecer, cuando los conductores y peatones se están adaptando a la oscuridad más temprana.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: Los estadounidenses dicen en las encuestas que quieren que terminen los cambios de hora, pero están menos unidos sobre qué hora mantener.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: Hasta que el Congreso elija una, y hasta que los estados obtengan la opción o el mandato de actuar, los relojes seguirán moviéndose dos veces al año.

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, la evidencia respalda una conclusión clara: cualquiera que sea la hora elegida, mantenerla todo el año probablemente sea mejor que cambiar de un lado a otro.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es para información general y no constituye asesoramiento médico.

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: Las personas con problemas de sueño o de salud deben hablar con un profesional de la salud calificado.*

segments.tr: هناك عدة أمور تبقي القضية عالقة:

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **الخلاف حول أي توقيت يجب جعله دائمًا.** يريد مؤيدو التوقيت الصيفي الدائم أمسيات طويلة على طراز الصيف طوال العام. يجادل العديد من علماء النوم بأن التوقيت *القياسي* الدائم هو الخيار الأفضل. يقسم هذان المعسكران تحالف الإصلاح.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **الاختلافات الإقليمية.** تختلف أوقات شروق الشمس وغروبها بشكل كبير في جميع أنحاء البلاد. التوقيت الصيفي الدائم يعني شروق شمس متأخر جدًا في الشتاء في بعض المناطق الشمالية والغربية من المنطقة الزمنية.

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **وقت محدود في الجلسات.** لدى الكونجرس العديد من الأولويات المتنافسة، ومن السهل تأجيل تغيير يمس كل ساعة في البلاد.

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## ما تقوله أدلة النوم

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: دعت منظمات طب النوم الرئيسية، بما في ذلك الأكاديمية الأمريكية لطب النوم، إلى القضاء على تغييرات الساعة الموسمية.

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: خيارهم المفضل هو التوقيت القياسي الدائم، لأنه يتطابق بشكل أوثق مع دورة الضوء والظلام الطبيعية للجسم.

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: ربط الباحثون التحول في الربيع، عندما نفقد ساعة، باضطرابات قصيرة المدى مثل قلة النوم والمزيد من النعاس أثناء النهار.

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: وجدت بعض الدراسات أيضًا زيادات صغيرة ومؤقتة في خطر الإصابة بالنوبات القلبية والسكتات الدماغية في الأيام التي تلي تغيير الربيع.

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: تصف هذه النتائج متوسطات عبر مجموعات سكانية كبيرة، وليست خطرًا سيواجهه كل فرد، لكنها سبب رئيسي لتفضيل المجموعات الصحية إنهاء التبديل.

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## السلامة والطاقة

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: صورة السلامة مختلطة.

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: يمكن لضوء النهار في المساء أن يقلل من بعض الجرائم وحوادث المرور التي تشمل المشاة عند الغسق.

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: قد تؤدي صباحات الشتاء الأكثر ظلمة في ظل التوقيت الصيفي الدائم إلى زيادة المخاطر على الأطفال الذين يمشون إلى المدرسة وللمتنقلين في الصباح الباكر.

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: وجدت الأبحاث حول معدلات الحوادث بعد تغييرات الساعة أيضًا ارتفاعات قصيرة الأجل، خاصة بعد تغيير الربيع.

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: حجة توفير الطاقة الأصلية أضعف مما يفترضه الكثيرون.

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: تجد الدراسات الحديثة عمومًا أن التأثير على استخدام الكهرباء ضئيل، وفي بعض المناطق يقترب من الصفر، لأن استخدام التدفئة والتبريد والإلكترونيات قد تغير منذ بدء السياسة.

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## الحجة الاقتصادية

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما دعمت مجموعات الأعمال وتجار التجزئة وقطاعات الترفيه والسياحة المزيد من ضوء النهار في المساء، بحجة أن الناس يتسوقون وينفقون أكثر عندما يكون الجو مضيئًا بعد العمل.

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: يشير آخرون إلى التكاليف الناتجة عن فقدان الإنتاجية بعد تغيير الربيع ومن الارتباك في تنسيق الجداول الزمنية عبر المناطق الزمنية، خاصة في النقل والبث والتمويل.

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: تختلف تقديرات التأثير الاقتصادي كثيرًا اعتمادًا على الطريقة المستخدمة، لذا يجب التعامل معها بحذر.

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## درس السبعينيات

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: لقد جربت الولايات المتحدة

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: هذا من قبل.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: في عام 1974، وافق الكونجرس على التوقيت الصيفي على مدار العام كتجربة لتوفير الطاقة.

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: انخفض الدعم العام خلال صباحات الشتاء المظلمة الأولى، وألغى الكونجرس الإجراء في العام التالي.

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: هذا التاريخ هو سبب رئيسي لحث المشرعين والعلماء على توخي الحذر بشأن التوقيت الدائم الذي يجب اختياره.

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن توقعه في نوفمبر هذا

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، لا شيء يتغير في القانون.

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: سيتحول شروق الشمس وغروبها ساعة واحدة في وقت أبكر في 1 نوفمبر، وستصبح الأمسيات مظلمة في وقت أقرب.

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: يمكن لبعض الخطوات العملية تسهيل التكيف:

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - قم بتغيير وقت النوم من 15 إلى 20 دقيقة في وقت أبكر لبضع ليالٍ مسبقًا.

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - احصل على ضوء خارجي في الصباح بعد التغيير.

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - حافظ على ثبات أوقات الوجبات والاستيقاظ.

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - توخَّ مزيدًا من الحذر عند القيادة عند الغسق، عندما يتكيف السائقون والمشاة مع الظلام المبكر.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: يقول الأمريكيون في الاستطلاعات إنهم يريدون إنهاء تغييرات الساعة، لكنهم أقل اتحادًا بشأن التوقيت الذي يجب الاحتفاظ به.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: حتى يختار الكونجرس واحدًا، وحتى تحصل الولايات على الخيار أو التفويض للتصرف، ستستمر الساعات في التحرك مرتين في السنة.

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، تدعم الأدلة استنتاجًا واحدًا واضحًا: أيًا كان التوقيت الذي يتم اختياره، فمن المرجح أن يكون البقاء عليه طوال العام أفضل من التبديل ذهابًا وإيابًا.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للمعلومات العامة ولا تشكل نصيحة طبية.

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: يجب على الأشخاص الذين لديهم مخاوف تتعلق بالنوم أو الصحة التحدث مع أخصائي صحي مؤهل.*

fr.title: Recul des horloges le 1er novembre : pourquoi l'Amérique ne parvient toujours pas à se mettre d'accord pour arrêter de changer d'heure

segments.src: In the early hours of **Sunday, November 1**, most of the United States will turn its clocks back one hour and return to standard time.
segments.tr: Aux premières heures du **dimanche 1er novembre**, la majeure partie des États-Unis reculera ses montres d'une heure et reviendra à l'heure standard.

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de gens profiteront d'une heure de sommeil supplémentaire.

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: Beaucoup poseront également une question familière : pourquoi faisons-nous encore cela ?

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: Les efforts pour mettre fin au changement d'heure bisannuel ont recueilli le soutien des deux partis, de la Maison-Blanche et d'une grande partie du public.

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: La législation visant à rendre l'heure d'été permanente est à nouveau au point mort au Congrès.

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: Voici où en est le débat, ce que dit la recherche et pourquoi les États ne peuvent tout simplement pas régler la question eux-mêmes.

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## Comment fonctionne le système actuel

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: Le Uniform Time Act de 1966 a créé un cadre national pour l'heure d'été (DST).

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: Selon les règles actuelles, l'heure d'été s'étend du deuxième dimanche de mars au premier dimanche de novembre.

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: Les États ont des choix limités en vertu de cette loi :

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **Ils peuvent rester à l'heure standard toute l'année.** Hawaï et la plus grande partie de l'Arizona font cela, ainsi que plusieurs territoires américains.

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **Ils ne peuvent pas adopter l'heure d'été permanente de leur propre chef.** Ce changement nécessite une loi du Congrès.

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: Environ vingt États ont adopté des lois ou des résolutions qui adopteraient l'heure d'été toute l'année si le Congrès le permet.

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: Ces mesures restent en suspens jusqu'à ce que la loi fédérale change.

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la démarche est au point mort

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: La proposition la plus connue est le Sunshine Protection Act, qui figerait l'heure d'été toute l'année.

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: Le Sénat a adopté une version par consentement unanime en 2022, mais elle n'a jamais fait l'objet d'un vote à la Chambre.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: Des versions ont été réintroduites lors de sessions ultérieures, et des déclarations publiques de soutien de dirigeants politiques ont suivi.

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: Cependant, aucun projet de loi n'a atteint le bureau du président.

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: Plusieurs raisons maintiennent le problème bloqué :

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **Désaccord sur l'heure à rendre permanente.** Les partisans de l'heure d'été permanente veulent de longues soirées estivales toute l'année. De nombreux spécialistes du sommeil soutiennent que l'heure *standard* permanente est le meilleur choix. Ces deux camps divisent la coalition de réforme.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **Différences régionales.** Les heures de lever et de coucher du soleil varient considérablement à travers le pays. L'heure d'été permanente signifierait des levers de soleil très tardifs en hiver dans certaines zones du nord et de l'ouest d'un fuseau horaire.

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **Temps de parole limité.** Le Congrès a de nombreuses priorités concurrentes, et un changement qui touche chaque horloge du pays est facile à reporter.

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## Ce que disent les données sur le sommeil

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: Les principales organisations de médecine du sommeil, y compris l'American Academy of Sleep Medicine, ont appelé à éliminer les changements d'heure saisonniers.

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: Leur option préférée est l'heure standard permanente, car elle correspond plus étroitement au cycle naturel lumière-obscurité du corps.

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs ont lié le changement de printemps, où nous perdons une heure, à des perturbations à court terme telles qu'un sommeil moindre et une somnolence diurne accrue.

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: Certaines études ont également trouvé de petites augmentations temporaires du risque de crise cardiaque et d'accident vasculaire cérébral dans les jours suivant le changement de printemps.

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: Ces résultats décrivent des moyennes sur de grandes populations, et non un risque que chaque individu connaîtra, mais ils constituent une raison principale pour laquelle les groupes de santé sont favorables à l'arrêt de ce changement.

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## Sécurité et énergie

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Le tableau de la sécurité est mitigé.

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: La lumière du soir peut réduire certains crimes et collisions routières impliquant des piétons au crépuscule.

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: Des matins d'hiver plus sombres sous l'heure d'été permanente pourraient augmenter les risques pour les enfants marchant vers l'école et pour les navetteurs matinaux.

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: La recherche sur les taux d'accidents après les changements d'heure a également révélé des pics de courte durée, en particulier après le changement de printemps.

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: L'argument original d'économie d'énergie est plus faible que beaucoup ne le supposent.

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: Les études modernes constatent généralement que l'effet sur la consommation d'électricité est faible, et dans certaines régions, il est proche de zéro, car l'utilisation du chauffage, de la climatisation et de l'électronique a changé depuis le début de la politique.

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## L'argument économique

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: Les groupes d'entreprises, les détaillants et les secteurs des loisirs et du tourisme ont souvent soutenu une plus grande luminosité en soirée, arguant que les gens achètent et dépensent plus lorsqu'il fait clair après le travail.

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: D'autres soulignent les coûts liés à la perte de productivité après le changement de printemps et à la confusion liée à la coordination des horaires entre les fuseaux horaires, en particulier dans les transports, la radiodiffusion et la finance.

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: Les estimations de l'effet économique varient considérablement selon la méthode utilisée, elles doivent donc être traitées avec prudence.

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## La leçon des années 1970

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: ont déjà essayé cela.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: En 1974, le Congrès a approuvé l'heure d'été toute l'année comme expérience d'économie d'énergie.

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: Le soutien du public a chuté pendant les premiers matins d'hiver sombres, et le Congrès a abrogé la mesure l'année suivante.

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: Cette histoire est une raison majeure pour laquelle les législateurs et les scientifiques exhortent à la prudence quant au choix de l'heure permanente.

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## À quoi s'attendre ce mois de novembre

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, rien ne change dans la loi.

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: Le lever et le coucher du soleil avanceront d'une heure le 1er novembre, et les soirées s'obscurciront plus tôt.

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: Certaines mesures pratiques peuvent faciliter l'ajustement :

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - Avancer l'heure du coucher de 15 à 20 minutes pendant quelques nuits au préalable.

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - S'exposer à la lumière extérieure le matin après le changement.

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - Maintenir des horaires de repas et de réveil stables.

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - Faire particulièrement attention en conduisant au crépuscule, lorsque les conducteurs et les piétons s'adaptent à l'obscurité plus matinale.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: Les Américains déclarent dans les sondages qu'ils veulent mettre fin aux changements d'heure, mais ils sont moins unis sur l'heure à conserver.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à ce que le Congrès en choisisse une, et que les États obtiennent l'option ou le mandat d'agir, les horloges continueront de bouger deux fois par an.

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: Entre-temps, les données soutiennent une conclusion claire : quelle que soit l'heure choisie, s'y tenir toute l'année sera probablement mieux que de faire des va-et-vient.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale et ne constitue pas un avis médical.

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: Les personnes ayant des problèmes de sommeil ou de santé doivent consulter un professionnel de la santé qualifié.*

segments.src: Legislation to make daylight saving time permanent has stalled in Congress again.
segments.tr: A legislação para tornar o horário de verão permanente estagnou no Congresso novamente.

segments.src: Here is where the debate stands, what research says, and why states can't simply settle the matter themselves.
segments.tr: Aqui está onde o debate se encontra, o que a pesquisa diz e por que os estados não podem simplesmente resolver a questão por conta própria.

segments.src: ## How the current system works
segments.tr: ## Como o sistema atual funciona

segments.src: The Uniform Time Act of 1966 created a national framework for daylight saving time (DST).
segments.tr: A Lei do Horário Uniforme de 1966 criou uma estrutura nacional para o horário de verão (DST).

segments.src: Under today's rules, DST runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
segments.tr: Sob as regras de hoje, o DST vai do segundo domingo de março ao primeiro domingo de novembro.

segments.src: States have limited choices under that law:
segments.tr: Os estados têm escolhas limitadas sob essa lei:

segments.src: - **They can stay on standard time all year.** Hawaii and most of Arizona do this, along with several U.S. territories.
segments.tr: - **Eles podem permanecer no horário padrão o ano todo.** O Havaí e a maior parte do Arizona fazem isso, junto com vários territórios dos EUA.

segments.src: - **They cannot adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.** That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: - **Eles não podem adotar o horário de verão permanente por conta própria.** Essa mudança exige um ato do Congresso.

segments.src: Roughly twenty states have passed laws or resolutions that would adopt year-round daylight saving time if Congress permits it.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente vinte estados aprovaram leis ou resoluções que adotariam o horário de verão o ano todo se o Congresso permitir.

segments.src: Those measures sit idle until federal law changes.
segments.tr: Essas medidas ficam paradas até que a lei federal mude.

segments.src: ## Why the push has stalled
segments.tr: ## Por que o impulso estagnou

segments.src: The best-known proposal is the Sunshine Protection Act, which would lock in daylight time year-round.
segments.tr: A proposta mais conhecida é a Lei de Proteção ao Sol, que travaria o horário de verão o ano todo.

segments.src: The Senate passed a version by unanimous consent in 2022, but it never received a vote in the House.
segments.tr: O Senado aprovou uma versão por consentimento unânime em 2022, mas ela nunca recebeu uma votação na Câmara.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later sessions, and public statements of support from political leaders have followed.
segments.tr: Versões foram reintroduzidas em sessões posteriores, e declarações públicas de apoio de líderes políticos se seguiram.

segments.src: Still, no bill has reached the president's desk.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, nenhum projeto chegou à mesa do presidente.

segments.src: Several things keep the issue stuck:
segments.tr: Várias coisas mantêm o problema travado:

segments.src: 1. **Disagreement over which time to make permanent.** Supporters of permanent daylight time want long summer-style evenings all year. Many sleep scientists argue permanent *standard* time is the better choice. Those two camps split the reform coalition.
segments.tr: 1. **Desacordo sobre qual horário tornar permanente.** Os defensores do horário de verão permanente querem noites longas estilo verão o ano todo. Muitos cientistas do sono argumentam que o horário *padrão* permanente é a melhor escolha. Esses dois campos dividem a coalizão de reforma.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** Sunrise and sunset times vary widely across the country. Permanent daylight time would mean very late winter sunrises in some northern and western areas of a time zone.
segments.tr: 2. **Diferenças regionais.** Os horários de nascer e pôr do sol variam amplamente em todo o país. O horário de verão permanente significaria amanheceres de inverno muito tardios em algumas áreas do norte e oeste de um fuso horário.

segments.src: 3. **Limited floor time.** Congress has many competing priorities, and a change that touches every clock in the country is easy to postpone.
segments.tr: 3. **Tempo de plenário limitado.** O Congresso tem muitas prioridades concorrentes, e uma mudança que toca cada relógio do país é fácil de adiar.

segments.src: ## What the sleep evidence says
segments.tr: ## O que a evidência do sono diz

segments.src: Major sleep medicine organizations, including the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, have called for eliminating seasonal clock changes.
segments.tr: Grandes organizações de medicina do sono, incluindo a Academia Americana de Medicina do Sono, pediram a eliminação das mudanças sazonais de horário.

segments.src: Their preferred option is permanent standard time, because it more closely matches the body's natural light-dark cycle.
segments.tr: Sua opção preferida é o horário padrão permanente, porque ele corresponde mais de perto ao ciclo natural de claro-escuro do corpo.

segments.src: Researchers have linked the spring shift, when we lose an hour, to short-term disruptions such as less sleep and more daytime drowsiness.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores associaram a mudança de primavera, quando perdemos uma hora, a interrupções de curto prazo, como menos sono e mais sonolência diurna.

segments.src: Some studies have also found small, temporary increases in heart attack and stroke risk in the days after the spring change.
segments.tr: Alguns estudos também encontraram aumentos pequenos e temporários no risco de ataque cardíaco e derrame nos dias após a mudança da primavera.

segments.src: These findings describe averages across large populations, not a risk that every individual will experience, but they are a main reason health groups favor ending the switch.
segments.tr: Essas descobertas descrevem médias em grandes populações, não um risco que cada indivíduo experimentará, mas são uma razão principal pela qual grupos de saúde favorecem o fim da mudança.

segments.src: ## Safety and energy
segments.tr: ## Segurança e energia

segments.src: The safety picture is mixed.
segments.tr: O panorama de segurança é misto.

segments.src: Evening daylight can reduce some crimes and traffic collisions involving pedestrians at dusk.
segments.tr: A luz do sol à tarde pode reduzir alguns crimes e colisões de trânsito envolvendo pedestres ao anoitecer.

segments.src: Darker winter mornings under permanent daylight time could raise risks for children walking to school and for early commuters.
segments.tr: Manhãs de inverno mais escuras sob o horário de verão permanente podem aumentar os riscos para crianças que vão para a escola a pé e para comensais matinais.

segments.src: Research on crash rates after clock changes has also found short-lived spikes, especially after the spring change.
segments.tr: A pesquisa sobre taxas de acidentes após mudanças de horário também encontrou picos de curta duração, especialmente após a mudança da primavera.

segments.src: The original energy-saving argument is weaker than many assume.
segments.tr: O argumento original de economia de energia é mais fraco do que muitos assumem.

segments.src: Modern studies generally find the effect on electricity use is small, and in some regions it is close to zero, because heating, cooling and electronics use have changed since the policy began.
segments.tr: Estudos modernos geralmente descobrem que o efeito no uso de eletricidade é pequeno, e em algumas regiões é próximo de zero, porque o uso de aquecimento, resfriamento e eletrônicos mudou desde que a política começou.

segments.src: ## The economic argument
segments.tr: ## O argumento econômico

segments.src: Business groups, retailers and the recreation and tourism sectors have often backed more evening daylight, arguing that people shop and spend more when it is light after work.
segments.tr: Grupos empresariais, varejistas e os setores de recreação e turismo frequentemente apoiaram mais luz solar à tarde, argumentando que as pessoas compram e gastam mais quando está claro após o expediente.

segments.src: Others point to costs from lost productivity after the spring change and from the confusion of coordinating schedules across time zones, especially in transportation, broadcasting and finance.
segments.tr: Outros apontam para os custos da produtividade perdida após a mudança da primavera e da confusão de coordenar horários entre fusos horários, especialmente em transporte, radiodifusão e finanças.

segments.src: Estimates of the economic effect vary a great deal depending on the method used, so they should be treated with caution.
segments.tr: Estimativas do efeito econômico variam muito dependendo do método usado, portanto devem ser tratadas com cautela.

segments.src: ## The lesson of the 1970s
segments.tr: ## A lição dos anos 1970

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Os EUA

segments.src: has tried this before.
segments.tr: já tentaram isso antes.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress approved year-round daylight time as an energy-saving experiment.
segments.tr: Em 1974, o Congresso aprovou o horário de verão o ano todo como um experimento de economia de energia.

segments.src: Public support dropped during the first dark winter mornings, and Congress repealed the measure the next year.
segments.tr: O apoio público caiu durante as primeiras manhãs escuras de inverno, e o Congresso revogou a medida no ano seguinte.

segments.src: That history is a major reason lawmakers and scientists urge care about which permanent time to choose.
segments.tr: Essa história é uma razão principal pela qual legisladores e cientistas pedem cuidado sobre qual horário permanente escolher.

segments.src: ## What to expect this November
segments.tr: ## O que esperar neste novembro

segments.src: For now, nothing changes in law.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, nada muda na lei.

segments.src: Sunrise and sunset will shift an hour earlier on November 1, and evenings will get dark sooner.
segments.tr: O nascer e o pôr do sol vão mudar uma hora mais cedo em 1º de novembro, e as noites escurecerão mais cedo.

segments.src: Some practical steps can ease the adjustment:
segments.tr: Alguns passos práticos podem facilitar a adaptação:

segments.src: - Shift bedtime 15 to 20 minutes earlier for a few nights beforehand.
segments.tr: - Mudar a hora de dormir 15 a 20 minutos mais cedo por algumas noites antes.

segments.src: - Get outdoor light in the morning after the change.
segments.tr: - Obter luz ao ar livre pela manhã após a mudança.

segments.src: - Keep meal and wake-up times steady.
segments.tr: - Manter os horários de refeição e de acordar estáveis.

segments.src: - Take extra care when driving at dusk, when drivers and pedestrians are adjusting to earlier darkness.
segments.tr: - Tomar cuidado extra ao dirigir ao anoitecer, quando motoristas e pedestres estão se adaptando à escuridão mais cedo.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: Americans say in surveys that they want an end to clock changes, but they are less united on which time to keep.
segments.tr: Os americanos dizem em pesquisas que querem um fim às mudanças de horário, mas estão menos unidos sobre qual horário manter.

segments.src: Until Congress picks one, and until states get the option or the mandate to act, the clocks will keep moving twice a year.
segments.tr: Até que o Congresso escolha um, e até que os estados tenham a opção ou o mandato para agir, os relógios continuarão se movendo duas vezes por ano.

segments.src: Meanwhile, the evidence supports one clear conclusion: whichever time is chosen, staying on it all year is likely to be better than switching back and forth.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, a evidência apoia uma conclusão clara: qualquer que seja o horário escolhido, permanecer nele o ano todo provavelmente será melhor do que alternar de um lado para o otro.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para informação geral e não constitui conselho médico.

segments.src: People with sleep or health concerns should speak with a qualified health professional.*
segments.tr: Pessoas com preocupações de sono ou saúde devem falar com um profissional de saúde qualificado.*

in.title: Jam Mundur pada 1 November: Mengapa Amerika Masih Belum Setuju untuk Berhenti Mengubah Waktu

segments.tr: Pada dini hari **Hari Minggu, 1 November**, sebagian besar wilayah Amerika Serikat akan memutar jam mereka mundur satu jam dan kembali ke waktu standar.

segments.src: Many people will enjoy an extra hour of sleep.
segments.tr: Banyak orang akan menikmati tambahan waktu tidur selama satu jam.

segments.src: Many will also be asking a familiar question: why are we still doing this?
segments.tr: Banyak juga yang akan mengajukan pertanyaan yang sudah tidak asing lagi: mengapa kita masih melakukan ini?

segments.src: Efforts to end the twice-a-year clock change have drawn support from both parties, from the White House and from large parts of the public.
segments.tr: Upaya untuk mengakhiri perubahan jam dua kali setahun telah mendapat dukungan dari kedua partai, dari Gedung White House, dan dari sebagian besar masyarakat.
